name: Precomputed Lighting (Baking)
definition: A technique to speed up rendering by pre-computing the lighting term (Li) and storing it in the grid's voxels, allowing the renderer to skip evaluating Li at each raymarching step on the camera ray.
summary: Precomputed Lighting (Baking) is a volume rendering optimization that pre-calculates incident radiance per voxel to accelerate rendering, differing from modular transfer by being static and view-independent.
